messages:
zara: promo stuck in CI prefetch, deploy-bot getting 504s from cache-service. change window open (~20m).
kevin: confirmed. prefetch retries 4/10 then backoff. artifact exists in registry, only cache pull failing.
deploy-bot: automated: promotion job=promo-550 state=PREFETCH_RETRY attempts=4/10 last_error=504 Gateway Timeout.
sam-oncall: looking at cache-service; s3-proxy queue high, threads pinned. i'll try a rolling restart of proxy workers and post metrics.
ankit: options: wait (risk missing window), abort, or manual promote pin+--skip-cache-prefetch. manual keeps window and is tested on staging.
zara: prefer manual pin+smoke+canary 2% for 30m if infra agrees. also add rollback target.
kevin: okay. running: `deploy-bot promote --env prod --image-sha sha256:33aabb77 --skip-cache-prefetch --tag manual-skip-2026-03-21`
deploy-bot: manual promote requested by kevin. job=promo-551 queued. prefetch skipped.
deploy-bot: promo-551 started -> success. prod image=sha256:33aabb77 tag=manual-skip-2026-03-21.
zara: starting smoke and 2% canary. monitoring 5xx and p95.
sam-oncall: after rolling restart 504s dropped from ~21% -> ~2% in 2m. incident INC-2026-03-cache-91 opened for postmortem (suspect proxy thread leak).
ankit: i'll update release notes: "Manual promotion due to cache prefetch 504s. Promoted sha256:33aabb77; prefetch skipped. Canary 2% for 30m. Rollback target sha256:99ffeedd."
kevin: rollback playbook added to release doc. follow-ups: add prefetch circuit-breaker to deploy-bot and doc skip-prefetch flow.
zara: pinning this thread to release doc and closing promo hold while canary runs. :white_check_mark:
